text:
morgan: Heads-up: a customer reported a series of 413s from /v1/embeddings when sending mixed-dim batches after the soft-quota tooltip shipped. They had 90x512 + 30x1536 in one request.

sujeet: Can you share the routing trace? Is this strictly a per-shard byte cap hitting or a pre-split failure?

morgan: Trace from staging:
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dim-Summary: 512:90,1536:30
Body size: ~3.9MB
Routing: shard-east-3 (max_payload_bytes=2097152) -> 413 Payload Too Large
Splitter: no-split (mixed dims, byte-split feature off)

eli: Current routing picks a shard based on the advertised dominant dim in the header. The splitter only auto-splits when dims are uniform or when client explicitly requests byte-splitting. Mixed dims often get routed to a smaller-capacity shard and fail.

roxanne: UX gap: console shows the soft-quota hint but doesn't offer an actionable split helper for mixed dims. Customers get the hint but still get blocked.

sujeet: Suggested plan: 1) Add a lightweight preflight check that estimates per-shard packing and returns a hint header when a likely cross-shard rejection is detected; 2) Surface that hint in the console with a clear CTA that either shows a copyable split curl or triggers an auto-retry via header; 3) Provide a server-side opt-in header for auto-splitting with idempotency.

eli: Implementation detail: server-side header `Prefer: embed_auto_split=adaptive` will cause ingress to attempt an adaptive dim-aware split and retry up to N=2 attempts. We will include `X-AutoSplit-Token` idempotency token in retries. We must ensure order-preservation across parts.

roxanne: Console copy draft: "Your request may fail on some nodes because it mixes vector sizes. Try "Split & Retry" (keeps order). Estimated success: Packed ~45% — Split x2 ~99%. Cost delta: packed $0.039 vs split $0.041. Clicking will show curl to run locally and also trigger the auto-split header if you re-run from the console"

morgan: Preflight header idea: `X-Embed-Preflight: want_suggestion=1` -> response `X-Embed-Suggest: parts=2;strategy=adaptive;reason=shard_byte_limit`. Also return light metrics in the response body like suggested_parts and estimated_success_pct for the console only.

sujeet: Telemetry constraints: do NOT log raw vectors. Telemetry events should only carry counts, dims distribution, total_bytes, suggested_parts, and target_shard_id. Example events: `embed.preflight_hint`, `embed.split_retry`, `embed.413_reject`.

eli: Runtime cost: preflight calculation is cheap (parsing dims header + bytes math) ~1ms. Adaptive splitting requires re-serializing smaller payloads and will add p50 ~12-20ms for an auto-retry. We need to surface that tradeoff in the console.

roxanne: Dashboard/KPI asks: show per-tenant 413 rate, preflight_hint_rate, split_adoption_rate, avg_latency_delta_when_split. Add alert: tenant 413 rate > 0.4% of embed traffic or split_adoption_rate < 30% when preflight_hint_rate > 1%.

morgan: Also propose a small API addition: `?split_strategy=adaptive&parts=2` query params for clients who want deterministic splits. The endpoint will return `X-Original-Order-Preserved: true` and `X-Split-Parts: 2` on success. Document that multi-part responses arrive in order.

sujeet: Edge cases: clients that rely on single-request atomicity might be surprised. We'll make auto-split opt-in only and put a big note in docs. Also ensure we don't break rate-limit accounting: split attempts should be charged as one logical request for quota calculations (but billed per actual tokens).

eli: Telemetry events to emit: `embed.preflight_hint(tenant, total_bytes, dims_hist, suggested_parts)`, `embed.split_attempt(tenant, parts, outcome)`, `embed.reject_413(tenant, shard_id)`. I'll add those to the instrumentation and wire up dashboard panels.

roxanne: I'll design two console mockups: 1) Inline preflight badge with "Split & Retry" and curl helper, 2) Expanded modal explaining tradeoffs + cost comparison. Support doc will include reproduction curl and how to opt into `Prefer` header.

infra-bot: Canary: preflight_hint and adaptive-auto-split will be rolled out to 15% of embedding ingress traffic in eng-platform on 2026-04-02T09:00Z.

morgan: Ok - next steps: @sujeet prototype preflight and query-param split, @eli hook telemetry and alerts, @roxanne mock console + support doc. We'll coordinate canary and customer outreach.

sujeet: I'll also add unit tests to ensure ordering is preserved and add a flag to disable auto-split per-tenant in runtime.

eli: I'll ensure telemetry excludes raw payloads and that dashboard panels show adoption and error recovery rates.

morgan: Thanks team. Capture this as an RFC follow-up and we'll triage for next sprint. :thumbsup:
